lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate (outer 2) to arm 3/6 (outer 6) at 90 deg. At 25/50/75% the perpendicular sections put the line on the outer-skin arc apex: points on the bisector sit at v within 0.02 mm, and the inner skin is at +2.94 mm. My own arc-presence scan puts the fold from about t=-0.5 (relief-slot edge) to t=18.0, and the line spans 0 to 17.6, so it covers about 95% with no overhang. The hits on the extended line beyond the start are the flat inner skin of the base plate (patch 1), not part of the fold. Parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate (outer 2) to arm 4/5 (outer 5) at 90 deg. The sections at 25/50/75% show the line on the outer arc apex, with on-bisector outer points at 0.00-0.02 mm and the inner skin at +2.9 mm. The fold runs from about t=0.0 to 18.0 and the line spans 0 to 17.6, so it covers about 98% with no overhang. The relief slot bounds the start. Parallel.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Return hook at the far end of arm 3/6, outer skins 6 and 10, about 128 deg bend (52 deg included). The sections at 25/50/75% show the line at the mid-arc outer apex, with on-bisector outer points within 0.01 mm and the inner skin at +2.95 mm. The fold runs from about t=-0.5 to 17.5 and the line spans 0 to 16.8, so it covers about 93% across the full arm width. Parallel.
